sentences.en: embody change, embody diversity, and can reach out to moderates and sound very reasonable to people in the political center.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这就是民主党人从巴拉克·奥巴马身上学到的经验

sentences.en: And that's, in a lot of ways, the lesson Democrats learned from Barack Obama
sentences.zh: 10年前的故事。

sentences.en: 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 只是这个经验在民主党基层已经不再被普遍接受了。

sentences.en: It's just a lesson that's no longer universally accepted in the Democratic base.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，就这实际上意味着未来几个月将如何进行治理而言，

sentences.en: So finally, in terms of what this actually means for governance right now in the coming months,
sentences.zh: 共和党人在参议院获得席位而民主党人控制众议院，其意义何在？

sentences.en: what's the significance of Republicans gaining seats in the Senate while Democrats have control of the House?
sentences.zh: 对民主党人来说最大的好消息是他们现在拥有了调查总统的权力，

sentences.en: The biggest good news for Democrats is they now have the power to investigate the president,
sentences.zh: 他们将能够不断向其政府成员发出传票。

sentences.en: that they are going to be able to issue subpoenas all the time to members of his administration.
sentences.zh: 他们不必指望特别检察官来进行各种各样的腐败调查。

sentences.en: They don't have to count on the special counsel to carry out all kinds of corruption investigations.
sentences.zh: 对共和党人来说最好的消息是，通过巩固他们的参议院多数地位，他们将更容易确认法官人选，他们已经明确表示这是他们的重中之重。

sentences.en: Best news for Republicans is by strengthening their Senate majority, they will have an easier time confirming judges, which they've made very clear is their biggest priority.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可能会迎来这样两年：一个我们已经认为相当失能的国会在立法意义上并没有真正的作为。

sentences.en: So we may be looking at two years in which a Congress we already regard as pretty dysfunctional doesn't really function much in the legislative sense.
sentences.zh: 它在众议院充当调查机构，在参议院充当制造法官的机器。

sentences.en: It functions as an investigatory body in the House and a judge-minting machine in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 这就是国会将如何运作。

sentences.en: And that's how Congress will work.
sentences.zh: 这就是国会将如何运作。

sentences.en: I think that's extremely well put.
sentences.zh: 我认为这话说得极其贴切。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alex.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: God bless Texas.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: Tonight is a victory for all the men and women in this room and all the men and women across
sentences.zh: 今晚是这个房间里所有的男男女女以及全州各地的

sentences.en: this state that poured your hearts, your passion, your time, your energy to rising to defend Texas.
sentences.zh: 所有倾注了心灵、热情、时间、精力挺身而出捍卫得克萨斯州的男男女女的胜利。

sentences.en: The people of Missouri allowed me, beginning when I was 28 years old, to serve the public, to serve them, to be a public servant.
sentences.zh: 密苏里州的人民允许我从28岁开始为公众服务，为他们服务，成为一名公务员。

sentences.en: And for decades, I have been blessed to get up every day.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我有幸每天都能醒来工作。

sentences.en: It has been such an honor.
sentences.zh: 这真是无上的荣誉。

sentences.en: And I, this state drives me crazy, but I love every corner of it.
sentences.zh: 而且我，这个州让我抓狂，但我爱它的每一个角落。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的爱。

sentences.en: I think the entire country has heard Tennessee loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 我想整个国家都听到了田纳西州响亮而清晰的声音。

sentences.en: I want to say a special thank you to the president and to the vice president for the support.
sentences.zh: 我要特别感谢总统和副总统的支持。

sentences.en: I've already talked to Vice President Pence and Mrs. Pence, and they are really excited.
sentences.zh: 我已经和彭斯副总统及彭斯夫人交谈过了，他们真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: They're excited for our family.
sentences.zh: 他们为我们的家庭感到兴奋。

sentences.en: They're excited for our state.
sentences.zh: 他们为我们的州感到兴奋。

sentences.en: They're excited for our country.
sentences.zh: 他们为我们的国家感到兴奋。

sentences.en: It's about our voices.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们的声音。

sentences.en: Say our voices.
sentences.zh: 大声说出我们的声音。

sentences.en: Our voices.
sentences.zh: 我们的声音。

sentences.en: Our votes.
sentences.zh: 我们的选票。

sentences.en: As-salamu alaykum.
sentences.zh: 阿萨兰姆阿莱库姆。

sentences.en: Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah.
sentences.zh: 赞美真主，赞美真主，赞美真主。

sentences.en: Thank you all for being here with us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家今晚能和我们在一起。

sentences.en: What an amazing journey this has been.
sentences.zh: 这是一段多么不可思议的旅程。

sentences.en: I've been here before you tonight as your congresswoman-elect with many firsts behind my name.
sentences.zh: 今晚我作为你们当选的女国会议员站在你们面前，身上有着许多个“第一”。

sentences.en: The first woman of color to represent our state in Congress.
sentences.zh: 第一位代表我们州进入国会的有色人种女性。

sentences.en: Women to wear hijab.

sentences.zh: 《每日秀》今天就到这里。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·博罗巴尔。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 以及首批当选国会议员的穆斯林女性之一。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力之争。
